prompt:
The image shows a card-style table with one Name column, several numeric columns, a rounded outer frame, and a shaded header row. Determine which selected row wins under the requested target-column extremum after applying the filter condition. What row name has the highest Time value among rows whose Mass entries satisfy values in Mass less than 7?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered supporting cell pairs [filter cell, target cell] for each selected row in top-to-bottom row order.
Answer: set "answer" to the exact row-name string from the filtered rows.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[260,236,372,292],[374,236,486,292]],"answer":"Ava"}
